The 'prepare' script runs 'npm test', which triggers a build and test sequence, a common and legitimate practice to ensure package quality before publication. Unlike the known malicious patterns, this snippet does not include any preinstall or install hooks that execute arbitrary code, nor does it reference missing or suspicious files. There is no evidence of obfuscation, data exfiltration, or system manipulation. The behavior aligns with standard development workflows rather than malicious intent.
